# Cubby UI

> Framework-agnostic UI component library. Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. No React, Vue, or any JS framework required. Components are designed to copy-paste directly into any project.

## Installation

```html
<!-- Option A: CDN -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.min.js"></script>

<!-- Option B: npm -->
<!-- npm install cubby-ui -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.css">
<script src="node_modules/cubby-ui/dist/core/cubby-ui.js"></script>
```

```js
// ES module
import 'cubby-ui/css';
import CubbyUI from 'cubby-ui';
```

## CSS Class Naming Convention

All classes use the `cu-` prefix.

- Base: `cu-{component}` — e.g. `cu-button`, `cu-input`, `cu-card`
- Variant: `cu-{component}-{variant}` — e.g. `cu-button-destructive`, `cu-badge-success`
- Size: `cu-{component}-{size}` — e.g. `cu-button-sm`, `cu-button-lg`
- Sub-element: `cu-{component}-{part}` — e.g. `cu-card-header`, `cu-sidebar-item`
- Wrapper: `cu-{component}-wrapper` — e.g. `cu-checkbox-wrapper`, `cu-select-wrapper`
- State: `cu-{component}-{part}-{state}` — e.g. `cu-sidebar-item-active`, `cu-tabs-trigger-active`
- Modifier: `cu-{component}-{modifier}` — e.g. `cu-card-hover` (opt-in shadow)

## JavaScript API

Interactive components are initialized automatically on `DOMContentLoaded`.

```js
CubbyUI.init()     // Initialize all interactive components. Safe to call repeatedly.
CubbyUI.destroy()  // Clear internal tracking arrays (use before SPA route transition).
CubbyUI.refresh()  // Remove stale refs + re-init (use after dynamic content updates).
```

Interactive components use `data-*` attributes — no JS calls required for markup-driven usage.

## Design System

Semantic color tokens (CSS variables, use in Tailwind or plain CSS):
- `--color-primary` / `--color-primary-foreground`
- `--color-secondary` / `--color-secondary-foreground`
- `--color-destructive` / `--color-destructive-foreground`
- `--color-success` / `--color-success-foreground`
- `--color-warning` / `--color-warning-foreground`
- `--color-info` / `--color-info-foreground`
- `--color-muted` / `--color-muted-foreground`
- `--color-accent` / `--color-accent-foreground`
- `--color-background` / `--color-foreground`
- `--color-card` / `--color-card-foreground`
- `--color-border`, `--color-input`, `--color-ring`

Dark mode: add `.dark` class on `<html>` or `<body>`.

---

## Components Reference

### Typography

**Headings**
```html
<h1 class="cu-h1">Heading 1</h1>
<h2 class="cu-h2">Heading 2</h2>
<h3 class="cu-h3">Heading 3</h3>
<h4 class="cu-h4">Heading 4</h4>
```

**Paragraph**
```html
<p class="cu-paragraph">Body text</p>
<p class="cu-paragraph cu-paragraph-lead">Lead paragraph (larger)</p>
```

**Kbd** — keyboard shortcut badge
Classes: `cu-kbd`, `cu-kbd-sm`, `cu-kbd-lg`
```html
<kbd class="cu-kbd">Ctrl</kbd>
```

**Blockquote**
```html
<blockquote class="cu-blockquote">Quote text</blockquote>
```

**List**
```html
<ul class="cu-list cu-list-disc"><li>Item</li></ul>
<ol class="cu-list cu-list-decimal"><li>Item</li></ol>
```

**Link**
```html
<a href="#" class="cu-link">Link text</a>
```

**HR**
```html
<hr class="cu-hr">
```

---

### Basic

**Aspect Ratio** — constrains child content to a specific aspect ratio
Classes: `cu-aspect-ratio` (container, relative + overflow-hidden), `cu-aspect-ratio-16/9`, `cu-aspect-ratio-4/3`, `cu-aspect-ratio-1/1`, `cu-aspect-ratio-21/9`
Child elements are stretched to fill via absolute positioning + `object-cover`.
```html
<div class="cu-aspect-ratio cu-aspect-ratio-16/9">
  <img src="photo.jpg" alt="Landscape">
</div>
```

**Button**
Base: `cu-button`
Variants: `cu-button-default` (solid primary), `cu-button-destructive`, `cu-button-outline`, `cu-button-ghost`, `cu-button-link`
Sizes: `cu-button-sm`, `cu-button-lg`
Icon buttons: `cu-button-icon` (h-9 w-9), `cu-button-icon-sm` (h-8 w-8), `cu-button-icon-xs` (h-7 w-7)
Block: `cu-button-block` (always full-width), `cu-button-block-sm` (full-width on mobile, auto on sm+)
```html
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Button</button>
<button class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-sm">Small Outline</button>
<button class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon" aria-label="Settings"><!-- icon svg --></button>
```

**Button Group**
```html
<div class="cu-button-group">
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Left</button>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Middle</button>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline">Right</button>
</div>
<!-- Vertical: add cu-button-group-vertical -->
```

**Card**
Sub-elements: `cu-card-header`, `cu-card-title`, `cu-card-description`, `cu-card-content`, `cu-card-footer`
Modifiers: `cu-card-hover` (opt-in hover shadow), `cu-card-elevated` (shadow-md), `cu-card-content-flush` (p-0 content)
Image: `cu-card-img-top` (top image with flush border radius)
Horizontal: `cu-card-horizontal` (flex-row layout), `cu-card-horizontal-img` (side image, w-48)
Selectable: `cu-card-selectable` (ring on checked state via `:has(input:checked)`)
```html
<div class="cu-card">
  <div class="cu-card-header">
    <h3 class="cu-card-title">Title</h3>
    <p class="cu-card-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-card-content">Content</div>
  <div class="cu-card-footer">Footer</div>
</div>
```

**Separator**
Requires explicit direction class.
```html
<hr class="cu-separator cu-separator-horizontal"> <!-- horizontal line -->
<div class="cu-separator cu-separator-vertical"></div> <!-- vertical line -->
```

---

### Forms

**Input**
Sizes: `cu-input-sm`, `cu-input-lg`
Validation: `cu-input-error`, `cu-input-success`
Clearable: `cu-input-clearable` (extra right padding for clear button), `cu-input-clear` (clear button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-input-clearable` (on container), `data-cu-input-clear` (on clear button)
```html
<input type="text" class="cu-input" placeholder="Placeholder">
<input type="text" class="cu-input cu-input-error" placeholder="Error state">
```

**Input Group** — combine input with text/icon addons
Classes: `cu-input-group` (flex container, merges border-radius), `cu-input-group-text` (text/icon addon with muted bg), `cu-input-group-disabled` (disabled state for entire group)
Children border-radius is auto-reset; first child gets `rounded-l-lg`, last gets `rounded-r-lg`. Adjacent children overlap borders with `-ml-px`.
```html
<div class="cu-input-group">
  <span class="cu-input-group-text">https://</span>
  <input type="text" class="cu-input" placeholder="example.com">
</div>
```

**Password Input** ⚡ Interactive — input with toggle visibility button
Classes: `cu-password-input` (container), `cu-password-input-field` (the text input, `pr-9` for toggle space), `cu-password-input-toggle` (eye icon button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-password-input`, `data-cu-password-toggle`, `data-cu-password-icon-show`, `data-cu-password-icon-hide`
```html
<div class="cu-password-input" data-cu-password-input>
  <input class="cu-password-input-field" type="password" placeholder="Enter password">
  <button type="button" class="cu-password-input-toggle" data-cu-password-toggle aria-label="Toggle password visibility">
    <svg data-cu-password-icon-show><!-- eye icon --></svg>
    <svg data-cu-password-icon-hide style="display:none"><!-- eye-off icon --></svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

**Pin Input** ⚡ Interactive — multi-digit verification code input
Classes: `cu-pin-input` (container), `cu-pin-input-field` (individual digit box)
Sizes: `cu-pin-input-sm`, `cu-pin-input-lg`
Error: `cu-pin-input-error` (destructive border)
Data attributes: `data-cu-pin-input`, `data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric|alphanumeric"`
```html
<div class="cu-pin-input" data-cu-pin-input data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
  <input class="cu-pin-input-field" type="text" maxlength="1" inputmode="numeric">
</div>
```

**Textarea**
Validation: `cu-textarea-error`, `cu-textarea-success`
Auto-resize: `cu-textarea-auto` (uses `field-sizing: content`)
```html
<textarea class="cu-textarea"></textarea>
<textarea class="cu-textarea cu-textarea-auto"></textarea>
```

**Label**
Required marker: `cu-label-required` (adds red asterisk after label)
```html
<label class="cu-label">Field Name</label>
<label class="cu-label cu-label-required">Required Field</label>
```

**Select** — custom arrow decoration
```html
<div class="cu-select-wrapper">
  <select class="cu-select">
    <option>Option 1</option>
  </select>
</div>
```

**Checkbox** — custom SVG checkmark
```html
<div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="cb1" class="cu-checkbox">
  <label for="cb1">Check me</label>
</div>
```

**Checkbox Group** — group of checkboxes with optional select-all
Classes: `cu-checkbox-group` (container), `cu-checkbox-group-label` (group label), `cu-checkbox-group-items` (items container, indented), `cu-checkbox-group-selectall` (select-all wrapper with bottom border)
```html
<div class="cu-checkbox-group">
  <span class="cu-checkbox-group-label">Interests</span>
  <div class="cu-checkbox-group-selectall">
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="all" class="cu-checkbox">
      <label for="all">Select All</label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-checkbox-group-items">
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="opt1" class="cu-checkbox">
      <label for="opt1">Option 1</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">
      <input type="checkbox" id="opt2" class="cu-checkbox">
      <label for="opt2">Option 2</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Color Picker** ⚡ Interactive — HSV saturation panel + hue slider + hex input + preset swatches
Classes: `cu-color-picker` (container, popover-styled), `cu-color-picker-saturation` (SV panel, crosshair cursor), `cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer` (draggable dot), `cu-color-picker-hue` (rainbow gradient bar), `cu-color-picker-hue-pointer` (draggable dot), `cu-color-picker-controls` (preview + input row), `cu-color-picker-preview` (color swatch), `cu-color-picker-input` (hex text field), `cu-color-picker-swatches` (grid container), `cu-color-picker-swatch` (individual swatch button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-color-picker`, `data-cu-color-picker-value`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-preview`, `data-cu-color-picker-input`, `data-cu-color-picker-hidden`, `data-cu-color-picker-swatch`
```html
<div class="cu-color-picker" data-cu-color-picker data-cu-color-picker-value="#ff0000">
  <div class="cu-color-picker-saturation" data-cu-color-picker-saturation>
    <div class="cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer" data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-color-picker-hue" data-cu-color-picker-hue>
    <div class="cu-color-picker-hue-pointer" data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-color-picker-controls">
    <div class="cu-color-picker-preview" data-cu-color-picker-preview></div>
    <input type="text" class="cu-color-picker-input" data-cu-color-picker-input value="#ff0000" maxlength="7">
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" data-cu-color-picker-hidden value="#ff0000">
  <div class="cu-color-picker-swatches">
    <button class="cu-color-picker-swatch" data-cu-color-picker-swatch="#ef4444" style="background-color: #ef4444;" aria-label="Select #ef4444"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Radio** — custom dot style
```html
<div class="cu-radio-wrapper">
  <input type="radio" id="r1" name="group" class="cu-radio">
  <label for="r1">Option</label>
</div>
```

**Toggle** — CSS-only, hidden checkbox + sibling
Sizes: `cu-toggle-sm`, `cu-toggle-lg`
```html
<div class="cu-toggle-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="t1" class="cu-toggle">
  <label for="t1">Toggle label</label>
</div>
```

**Range** (slider)
```html
<input type="range" class="cu-range" min="0" max="100" value="50">
```

**Search Input**
```html
<div class="cu-search-input-wrapper">
  <input type="search" class="cu-search-input" placeholder="Search...">
</div>
```

**File Input**
```html
<div class="cu-file-input-wrapper">
  <input type="file" class="cu-file-input">
</div>
```

**Form Group** — wraps label + input + description/error
```html
<div class="cu-form-group">
  <label class="cu-label cu-label-required">Name</label>
  <input class="cu-input">
  <p class="cu-form-description">Helper text</p>
  <p class="cu-form-error">Error message</p>
</div>
```

**Number Input** ⚡ Interactive
`data-cu-number-input` on container, `data-cu-number-field` on `<input>`, `data-cu-number-decrement` / `data-cu-number-increment` on buttons.
```html
<div class="cu-number-input" data-cu-number-input>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-icon-sm" data-cu-number-decrement>−</button>
  <input type="number" class="cu-input" data-cu-number-field min="0" max="100" step="1" value="0">
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline cu-button-icon-sm" data-cu-number-increment>+</button>
</div>
```

**Combobox** ⚡ Interactive — searchable select
Key data attributes: `data-cu-combobox`, `data-cu-combobox-trigger`, `data-cu-combobox-content`, `data-cu-combobox-input`, `data-cu-combobox-item`, `data-cu-combobox-value`, `data-cu-combobox-empty`, `data-cu-combobox-list`
Active item: add `cu-combobox-item-active` class to pre-selected item.
```html
<div class="cu-combobox" data-cu-combobox>
  <button class="cu-combobox-trigger" data-cu-combobox-trigger>
    <span data-cu-combobox-value class="cu-combobox-trigger-placeholder">Select...</span>
  </button>
  <div class="cu-combobox-content" data-cu-combobox-content hidden>
    <input class="cu-combobox-input" data-cu-combobox-input placeholder="Search...">
    <ul data-cu-combobox-list>
      <li class="cu-combobox-item" data-cu-combobox-item>Option 1</li>
      <li class="cu-combobox-item" data-cu-combobox-item>Option 2</li>
    </ul>
    <div data-cu-combobox-empty hidden>No results</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Date Picker** ⚡ Interactive — calendar popup for date selection
Calendar classes: `cu-calendar` (container, popover-styled), `cu-calendar-header` (month/year nav row), `cu-calendar-title` (current month text), `cu-calendar-nav` (prev/next button), `cu-calendar-weekdays` (weekday header grid), `cu-calendar-weekday` (individual weekday), `cu-calendar-grid` (day grid), `cu-calendar-day` (day cell), `cu-calendar-day-today` (today highlight), `cu-calendar-day-selected` (selected day, primary bg), `cu-calendar-day-outside` (prev/next month days, dimmed), `cu-calendar-day-disabled` (non-selectable)
Picker classes: `cu-date-picker` (wrapper), `cu-date-picker-trigger` (input-like button), `cu-date-picker-trigger-icon` (calendar icon), `cu-date-picker-trigger-placeholder` (placeholder text style), `cu-date-picker-content` (dropdown container)
Data attributes: `data-cu-date-picker`, `data-cu-date-picker-trigger`, `data-cu-date-picker-value`, `data-cu-date-picker-input` (hidden input), `data-cu-date-picker-content`
```html
<div class="cu-date-picker" data-cu-date-picker>
  <button type="button" class="cu-date-picker-trigger" data-cu-date-picker-trigger>
    <svg class="cu-date-picker-trigger-icon"><!-- calendar icon --></svg>
    <span data-cu-date-picker-value class="cu-date-picker-trigger-placeholder">Pick a date</span>
  </button>
  <input type="hidden" data-cu-date-picker-input value="">
  <div class="cu-date-picker-content" data-cu-date-picker-content>
    <div class="cu-calendar">
      <div class="cu-calendar-header">
        <button class="cu-calendar-nav">‹</button>
        <span class="cu-calendar-title">March 2026</span>
        <button class="cu-calendar-nav">›</button>
      </div>
      <div class="cu-calendar-weekdays">
        <span class="cu-calendar-weekday">Su</span>
        <!-- ...Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa -->
      </div>
      <div class="cu-calendar-grid">
        <button class="cu-calendar-day cu-calendar-day-today">15</button>
        <button class="cu-calendar-day cu-calendar-day-selected">20</button>
        <button class="cu-calendar-day cu-calendar-day-outside">1</button>
        <!-- ...more days -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Multi Select** ⚡ Interactive — multiple selection with tags
Key data attributes: `data-cu-multi-select`, `data-cu-multi-select-trigger`, `data-cu-multi-select-content`, `data-cu-multi-select-input`, `data-cu-multi-select-item` (with `data-cu-value`), `data-cu-multi-select-tags`, `data-cu-multi-select-placeholder`, `data-cu-multi-select-list`, `data-cu-multi-select-empty`
```html
<div class="cu-multi-select" data-cu-multi-select>
  <div class="cu-multi-select-trigger" data-cu-multi-select-trigger>
    <div data-cu-multi-select-tags>
      <span data-cu-multi-select-placeholder>Select options...</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-multi-select-content" data-cu-multi-select-content hidden>
    <input class="cu-multi-select-input" data-cu-multi-select-input placeholder="Search...">
    <ul data-cu-multi-select-list>
      <li class="cu-multi-select-item" data-cu-multi-select-item data-cu-value="opt1">Option 1</li>
      <li class="cu-multi-select-item" data-cu-multi-select-item data-cu-value="opt2">Option 2</li>
    </ul>
    <div data-cu-multi-select-empty hidden>No results</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Dropzone** ⚡ Interactive — drag-and-drop file upload
```html
<div class="cu-dropzone" data-cu-dropzone>
  <input type="file" data-cu-dropzone-input class="sr-only" multiple>
  <p>Drop files here or click to upload</p>
</div>
```
Active drag state: `cu-dropzone-active` class is toggled automatically.

**Transfer List** ⚡ Interactive — move items between two lists
```html
<div class="cu-transfer-list" data-cu-transfer-list>
  <div data-cu-transfer-panel="left">
    <input data-cu-transfer-search="left" placeholder="Search...">
    <input type="checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check-all="left">
    <span data-cu-transfer-count="left"></span>
    <ul class="cu-transfer-list-content">
      <li class="cu-transfer-list-item">
        <input type="checkbox" data-cu-transfer-check data-cu-value="item1">
        <span>Item 1</span>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div>
    <button data-cu-transfer-to-right class="cu-button cu-button-outline">→</button>
    <button data-cu-transfer-to-left class="cu-button cu-button-outline">←</button>
  </div>
  <div data-cu-transfer-panel="right">
    <!-- same structure as left panel -->
  </div>
</div>
```

**Toggle Group** — switchable button group (single or multiple selection)
Classes: `cu-toggle-group`, `cu-toggle-group-item`, `cu-toggle-group-item-active`, `cu-toggle-group-outline`, `cu-toggle-group-multiple`, `cu-toggle-group-sm`, `cu-toggle-group-lg`, `cu-toggle-group-block`
Data: `data-cu-toggle-group`, `data-cu-toggle-group-multiple`
```html
<div class="cu-toggle-group" data-cu-toggle-group>
  <button class="cu-toggle-group-item cu-toggle-group-item-active">List</button>
  <button class="cu-toggle-group-item">Grid</button>
  <button class="cu-toggle-group-item">Board</button>
</div>

<!-- Multiple selection -->
<div class="cu-toggle-group cu-toggle-group-multiple" data-cu-toggle-group data-cu-toggle-group-multiple>
  <button class="cu-toggle-group-item cu-toggle-group-item-active">Bold</button>
  <button class="cu-toggle-group-item">Italic</button>
</div>
```

**Rating** — star rating for reviews and feedback
Classes: `cu-rating`, `cu-rating-item`, `cu-rating-item-active`, `cu-rating-item-half`, `cu-rating-readonly`, `cu-rating-disabled`, `cu-rating-sm`, `cu-rating-lg`
Data: `data-cu-rating`, `data-cu-rating-star="N"`, `data-cu-rating-value="N"`
```html
<!-- Readonly display -->
<div class="cu-rating cu-rating-readonly">
  <span class="cu-rating-item cu-rating-item-active"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item cu-rating-item-active"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item"><svg>★</svg></span>
</div>

<!-- Interactive -->
<div class="cu-rating" data-cu-rating data-cu-rating-value="0">
  <span class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="1"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="2"><svg>★</svg></span>
  <span class="cu-rating-item" data-cu-rating-star="3"><svg>★</svg></span>
</div>
```

**Tag Input** — input for adding/removing tags with keyboard
Classes: `cu-tag-input`, `cu-tag-input-field`, `cu-tag-input-tag`, `cu-tag-input-tag-remove`, `cu-tag-input-primary`, `cu-tag-input-outline`, `cu-tag-input-error`, `cu-tag-input-success`, `cu-tag-input-disabled`
Data: `data-cu-tag-input`, `data-cu-tag-input-field`, `data-cu-tag-max="N"`, `data-cu-tag-value`
```html
<div class="cu-tag-input" data-cu-tag-input>
  <span class="cu-tag-input-tag" data-cu-tag-value="React">
    React
    <button class="cu-tag-input-tag-remove" type="button">&times;</button>
  </span>
  <input class="cu-tag-input-field" data-cu-tag-input-field placeholder="Add tag..." />
</div>
```

**Floating Label** — Material Design-style input with floating label
Classes: `cu-floating-label`, `cu-floating-label-input`, `cu-floating-label-text`, `cu-floating-label-textarea`, `cu-floating-label-error`, `cu-floating-label-success`
```html
<div class="cu-floating-label">
  <input class="cu-floating-label-input" placeholder=" " />
  <label class="cu-floating-label-text">Email</label>
</div>
```
Note: Input MUST have `placeholder=" "` (space) for the CSS `:placeholder-shown` selector to work.

---

### Data Display

**Avatar**
Sizes: `cu-avatar-sm`, `cu-avatar-lg`, `cu-avatar-xl`
Status: `cu-avatar-status` + `cu-avatar-status-online` / `cu-avatar-status-offline` / `cu-avatar-status-busy` / `cu-avatar-status-away`
Shape: `cu-avatar-square` (rounded-lg instead of rounded-full)
Ring: `cu-avatar-ring`
```html
<div class="cu-avatar">
  <img class="cu-avatar-image" src="photo.jpg" alt="User">
  <span class="cu-avatar-fallback">AB</span>
</div>
```

**Badge**
Variants: `cu-badge-default`, `cu-badge-secondary`, `cu-badge-destructive`, `cu-badge-outline`, `cu-badge-success`, `cu-badge-warning`, `cu-badge-info`
Sizes: `cu-badge-sm`, `cu-badge-lg`
Dot animation: `cu-badge-dot-animated` (pulsing animation on dot indicator)
```html
<span class="cu-badge cu-badge-default">New</span>
<span class="cu-badge cu-badge-success cu-badge-sm">Active</span>
```

**Code Block** — syntax-highlighted code display with optional header and copy button
Classes: `cu-code-block` (container, dark bg), `cu-code-block-header` (top bar with filename/language + copy btn), `cu-code-block-pre` (scrollable code area), `cu-code-block-copy` (copy button, absolute top-right when no header, inline when inside header)
Copied state: add `data-cu-copied` attribute to `cu-code-block-copy` to show success styling.
```html
<div class="cu-code-block">
  <div class="cu-code-block-header">
    <span>index.js</span>
    <button class="cu-code-block-copy">Copy</button>
  </div>
  <pre class="cu-code-block-pre"><code>const x = 42;</code></pre>
</div>

<!-- Without header (copy button floats top-right) -->
<div class="cu-code-block">
  <button class="cu-code-block-copy">Copy</button>
  <pre class="cu-code-block-pre"><code>npm install cubby-ui</code></pre>
</div>
```

**Accordion** ⚡ CSS-driven (open/close via HTML `open` attribute on `<details>`)
```html
<div class="cu-accordion">
  <details class="cu-accordion-item">
    <summary class="cu-accordion-trigger">Section Title</summary>
    <div class="cu-accordion-content">Content here</div>
  </details>
</div>
```

**Marquee** — infinitely scrolling content (logo walls, testimonials). Pure CSS.
Classes: `cu-marquee`, `cu-marquee-content`, `cu-marquee-item`, `cu-marquee-reverse`, `cu-marquee-vertical`, `cu-marquee-fade`, `cu-marquee-pause-on-hover`
CSS Variable: `--cu-marquee-duration` (default: 30s)
```html
<div class="cu-marquee cu-marquee-fade" style="--cu-marquee-duration: 20s;">
  <div class="cu-marquee-content">
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Acme</span>
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Globex</span>
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Initech</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-marquee-content" aria-hidden="true">
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Acme</span>
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Globex</span>
    <span class="cu-marquee-item px-8">Initech</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Sortable List** — drag-and-drop reorderable list
Classes: `cu-sortable-list`, `cu-sortable-item`, `cu-sortable-handle`, `cu-sortable-content`, `cu-sortable-placeholder`, `cu-sortable-item-dragging`, `cu-sortable-item-disabled`, `cu-sortable-list-bordered`, `cu-sortable-list-compact`

```html
<div class="cu-sortable-list" data-cu-sortable-list>
```

**Countdown** — countdown timer to a target date

**Image Compare** — before/after image comparison slider

Dot colors: `cu-timeline-dot-primary/success/warning/destructive/info`. **Tree View** — `cu-tree`, `cu-tree-item` (`<details>`), `cu-tree-trigger` (`<summary>`), `cu-tree-trigger-icon`, `cu-tree-content`, `cu-tree-leaf`, `cu-tree-leaf-active`. Uses native `<details>`/`<summary>` for expand/collapse.

```html
<div class="cu-tree">
```

Expandable rows: `cu-data-table-expand-trigger` (row expand/collapse trigger), `cu-data-table-expanded-row` (active parent row state), `cu-data-table-expanded-content` (expanded content area)
Data attributes: `data-cu-data-table-expandable` (on table container), `data-cu-expand-row` (on expand trigger)
```html
<div class="cu-data-table cu-data-table-striped">

    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Diff Viewer** — code diff display (unified or side-by-side)
Classes: `cu-diff-viewer`, `cu-diff-viewer-header`, `cu-diff-viewer-filename`, `cu-diff-viewer-hunk`, `cu-diff-viewer-line`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-number`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-content`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-added`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-removed`, `cu-diff-viewer-line-unchanged`, `cu-diff-viewer-side-by-side`, `cu-diff-viewer-side`, `cu-diff-viewer-word-added`, `cu-diff-viewer-word-removed`
```html
<div class="cu-diff-viewer">
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-header">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-filename">src/app.js</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-hunk">@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@</div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-unchanged">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">1</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">import React from 'react';</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-removed">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">2</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">const App = () => null;</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-diff-viewer-line cu-diff-viewer-line-added">
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-number">2</span>
    <span class="cu-diff-viewer-line-content">const App = () => &lt;div&gt;Hello&lt;/div&gt;;</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Feedback

**Alert**
Variants: `cu-alert-default`, `cu-alert-destructive`, `cu-alert-success`, `cu-alert-warning`, `cu-alert-info`
Modifier: `cu-alert-accent` (left border stripe)
Expandable: `cu-alert-expandable-content` (expandable content area), `cu-alert-expand-trigger` (expand toggle button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-alert-expandable` (on container), `data-cu-alert-expand-trigger` (on toggle button), `data-cu-alert-expandable-content` (on content area)
```html
<div class="cu-alert cu-alert-success">
  <div class="cu-alert-title">Success</div>
  <div class="cu-alert-description">Operation completed.</div>
</div>
```

**Progress**
Modifiers: `cu-progress-bar-striped`, `cu-progress-bar-striped-animated`, `cu-progress-bar-gradient`
Multi-segment: `cu-progress-multi` (container for multiple `cu-progress-bar` segments side by side)
Circular progress: `cu-progress-circular` (SVG container), `cu-progress-circular-track` (background track), `cu-progress-circular-bar` (progress bar stroke), `cu-progress-circular-value` (centered value label)
Circular color variants: `cu-progress-circular-bar-success`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-warning`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-destructive`, `cu-progress-circular-bar-info`
Circular animation: `cu-progress-circular-indeterminate` (spinning animation)
```html
<div class="cu-progress">
  <div class="cu-progress-bar" style="width: 60%"></div>
</div>
```

**Skeleton**
Variants: `cu-skeleton` (pulse), `cu-skeleton-shimmer` (sweep animation)
Shapes: `cu-skeleton-circle`, `cu-skeleton-text`
```html
<div class="cu-skeleton" style="width: 200px; height: 20px"></div>
<div class="cu-skeleton cu-skeleton-circle" style="width: 40px; height: 40px"></div>
```

**Spinner**
Sizes: `cu-spinner-sm` (16px), `cu-spinner-md` (24px), `cu-spinner-lg` (32px, thicker border)
Colors: `cu-spinner-primary`, `cu-spinner-secondary`, `cu-spinner-destructive`, `cu-spinner-success`, `cu-spinner-warning`, `cu-spinner-info`, `cu-spinner-muted`
```html
<div class="cu-spinner cu-spinner-md"></div>
<div class="cu-spinner cu-spinner-lg cu-spinner-primary"></div>
```

**Empty State**
```html
<div class="cu-empty-state">
  <div class="cu-empty-state-icon"><!-- icon --></div>
  <div class="cu-empty-state-title">Nothing here</div>
  <div class="cu-empty-state-description">Get started by adding an item.</div>
  <div class="cu-empty-state-action">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Add Item</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Notification** — static notification cards for activity feeds and panels
Classes: `cu-notification`, `cu-notification-icon`, `cu-notification-content`, `cu-notification-title`, `cu-notification-description`, `cu-notification-time`, `cu-notification-actions`, `cu-notification-close`, `cu-notification-unread`, `cu-notification-list`
Variants: `cu-notification-info`, `cu-notification-success`, `cu-notification-warning`, `cu-notification-destructive`
```html
<div class="cu-notification cu-notification-unread">
  <div class="cu-notification-icon">🔔</div>
  <div class="cu-notification-content">
    <div class="cu-notification-title">New message</div>
    <div class="cu-notification-description">You have a new message from Alex.</div>
    <div class="cu-notification-time">2 min ago</div>
  </div>
  <button class="cu-notification-close">&times;</button>
</div>
```

**Toast** ⚡ Interactive — triggered by button click, auto-dismissed
Variants: `cu-toast-default`, `cu-toast-destructive`, `cu-toast-success`, `cu-toast-warning`, `cu-toast-info`
Toast container is auto-created if missing. Customize with `data-cu-toast-container` attributes.
```html
<!-- Trigger button -->
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default"
  data-cu-toast-trigger
  data-cu-toast-title="Saved!"
  data-cu-toast-description="Your changes have been saved."
  data-cu-toast-variant="success"
  data-cu-toast-duration="4000">
  Save
</button>

<!-- Optional: explicit container (auto-created at bottom-right if omitted) -->
<div class="cu-toast-container cu-toast-container-bottom-right"
  data-cu-toast-container
  data-cu-toast-max="5">
</div>
```
Container position variants: `cu-toast-container-top-right`, `cu-toast-container-top-left`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-right`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-left`, `cu-toast-container-top-center`, `cu-toast-container-bottom-center`
Action classes: `cu-toast-action` (action button container), `cu-toast-action-btn` (action button styling)
Programmatic API: `CubbyUI.toast.show({ title, description, variant, duration, action })` — show a toast via JS. `CubbyUI.toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` — bind toast states to a Promise lifecycle.

---

### Overlay

**Command Palette** ⚡ Interactive — keyboard-driven command search overlay, uses native `<dialog>`
Classes: `cu-command` (dialog container, centered, max-w-lg), `cu-command-input-wrapper` (search bar row with border-bottom), `cu-command-input-icon` (search icon), `cu-command-input` (text input), `cu-command-list` (scrollable results), `cu-command-group` (group container), `cu-command-group-heading` (group label), `cu-command-item` (selectable row), `cu-command-separator` (divider), `cu-command-shortcut` (right-aligned shortcut text), `cu-command-empty` (no results message)
Active item: `data-cu-command-active` attribute highlights item.
Data attributes: `data-cu-command`
```html
<dialog class="cu-command" data-cu-command>
  <div class="cu-command-input-wrapper">
    <svg class="cu-command-input-icon"><!-- search icon --></svg>
    <input class="cu-command-input" placeholder="Type a command or search...">
  </div>
  <div class="cu-command-list">
    <div class="cu-command-group">
      <div class="cu-command-group-heading">Suggestions</div>
      <button class="cu-command-item">
        Calendar
        <span class="cu-command-shortcut"><kbd class="cu-kbd cu-kbd-sm">⌘K</kbd></span>
      </button>
      <button class="cu-command-item">Search</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-command-separator"></div>
    <div class="cu-command-empty">No results found.</div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Context Menu** ⚡ Interactive — right-click triggered menu
Classes: `cu-context-menu` (wrapper), `cu-context-menu-content` (popup panel, reuses dropdown item styles)
Menu items use `cu-dropdown-item`, `cu-dropdown-label`, `cu-dropdown-separator` classes.
Data attributes: `data-cu-context-menu`, `data-cu-context-menu-content`
```html
<div class="cu-context-menu" data-cu-context-menu>
  <div>Right-click this area</div>
  <div class="cu-context-menu-content" data-cu-context-menu-content hidden>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Cut</button>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Copy</button>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Paste</button>
    <div class="cu-dropdown-separator"></div>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Delete</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Dialog** ⚡ Interactive — uses native `<dialog>` element
Sizes: `cu-dialog-sm`, `cu-dialog-md` (default), `cu-dialog-xl`, `cu-dialog-full`
Scrollable layout: `cu-dialog-body` (flex column with max-height), `cu-dialog-scroll` (scrollable content area)
Trigger attribute value must match `<dialog id="...">`.
```html
<!-- Trigger -->
<button class="cu-button cu-button-default" data-cu-dialog-trigger="my-dialog">Open</button>

<!-- Dialog -->
<dialog id="my-dialog" class="cu-dialog">
  <div class="cu-dialog-header">
    <h2 class="cu-dialog-title">Dialog Title</h2>
    <p class="cu-dialog-description">Description text.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-dialog-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-dialog-close>Cancel</button>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Confirm</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Drawer** ⚡ Interactive — side panel, uses native `<dialog>`
Directions: `cu-drawer-right` (default), `cu-drawer-left`, `cu-drawer-top`, `cu-drawer-bottom`
```html
<button data-cu-drawer-trigger="my-drawer" class="cu-button cu-button-default">Open Drawer</button>

<dialog id="my-drawer" class="cu-drawer cu-drawer-right">
  <div class="cu-drawer-header">
    <h2 class="cu-drawer-title">Drawer Title</h2>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon" data-cu-drawer-close aria-label="Close">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-drawer-content">Content</div>
  <div class="cu-drawer-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-drawer-close>Close</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Alert Dialog** ⚡ Interactive — blocking confirmation, uses native `<dialog>`
Closes on cancel or action buttons (NOT on backdrop click).
```html
<button data-cu-alert-dialog-trigger="confirm-dialog" class="cu-button cu-button-destructive">Delete</button>

<dialog id="confirm-dialog" class="cu-alert-dialog">
  <div class="cu-alert-dialog-header">
    <h2 class="cu-alert-dialog-title">Are you sure?</h2>
    <p class="cu-alert-dialog-description">This action cannot be undone.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-alert-dialog-footer">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-alert-dialog-cancel>Cancel</button>
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-destructive" data-cu-alert-dialog-action>Delete</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

**Dropdown Menu** ⚡ Interactive
```html
<div class="cu-dropdown" data-cu-dropdown>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-dropdown-trigger>Options ▾</button>
  <div class="cu-dropdown-content" data-cu-dropdown-content hidden>
    <div class="cu-dropdown-label">Actions</div>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Edit</button>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Duplicate</button>
    <div class="cu-dropdown-separator"></div>
    <button class="cu-dropdown-item">Delete</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Popover** ⚡ Interactive — click to toggle panel

```html
<div class="cu-popover" data-cu-popover>
  <button class="cu-button cu-button-outline" data-cu-popover-trigger>Info</button>
```

**Menubar** ⚡ Interactive — top-level menu bar with sub-menus

```html
<div class="cu-menubar" data-cu-menubar>
  <div class="cu-menubar-menu" data-cu-menubar-menu>
    <button class="cu-menubar-trigger" data-cu-menubar-trigger>File</button>
    <div class="cu-menubar-content" data-cu-menubar-content hidden>
      <button class="cu-menubar-item">New</button>
```

**Tour** ⚡ Interactive — guided tour overlay with spotlight highlighting
Classes: `cu-tour-overlay`, `cu-tour-spotlight`, `cu-tour-tooltip`, `cu-tour-tooltip-title`, `cu-tour-tooltip-description`, `cu-tour-tooltip-footer`, `cu-tour-tooltip-progress`, `cu-tour-tooltip-actions`, `cu-tour-dots`, `cu-tour-dot`, `cu-tour-dot-active`, `cu-tour-target`
Data: `data-cu-tour`, `data-cu-tour-steps` (JSON array), `data-cu-tour-auto`
```html
<div data-cu-tour data-cu-tour-steps='[
  {"target": "#step1", "title": "Welcome", "description": "This is the first step.", "placement": "bottom"},
  {"target": "#step2", "title": "Features", "description": "Explore our features.", "placement": "right"}
]'>
</div>
```
Programmatic start: `el.dispatchEvent(new Event("cu:tour:start"))`

### Navigation

**Tabs** ⚡ Interactive — show/hide panels
Active trigger: `cu-tabs-trigger-active`
Variants: `cu-tabs-list-pills` (pill-shaped tab bar)
Tab extras: `cu-tabs-trigger-badge` (badge inside tab trigger), `cu-tabs-trigger-close` (close button inside tab trigger)
Scrollable: `cu-tabs-list-scrollable` (scrollable wrapper), `cu-tabs-scroll-btn` (scroll left button), `cu-tabs-scroll-btn-end` (scroll right button)
Data attributes: `data-cu-tabs-close` (on close button), `data-cu-tabs-scrollable` (on scrollable wrapper)
```html
<div class="cu-tabs" data-cu-tabs>
  <div class="cu-tabs-list">
    <button class="cu-tabs-trigger cu-tabs-trigger-active" data-cu-tabs-trigger="tab1">Tab 1</button>
    <button class="cu-tabs-trigger" data-cu-tabs-trigger="tab2">Tab 2</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-tabs-content" data-cu-tabs-content="tab1">Panel 1</div>
  <div class="cu-tabs-content" data-cu-tabs-content="tab2" hidden>Panel 2</div>
</div>
```

**Breadcrumb**
Collapsed items: `cu-breadcrumb-ellipsis` (clickable ellipsis for collapsed breadcrumb items)
```html
<nav class="cu-breadcrumb">
  <ol>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-item">
      <a href="/" class="cu-breadcrumb-link">Home</a>
    </li>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-separator">/</li>
    <li class="cu-breadcrumb-item">
      <span class="cu-breadcrumb-current">Current Page</span>
    </li>
  </ol>
</nav>
```

**Pagination**
Active: `cu-pagination-item-active`
```html
<nav class="cu-pagination">
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-prev">Previous</a>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-item cu-pagination-item-active">1</a>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-item">2</a>
  <span class="cu-pagination-ellipsis">…</span>
  <a href="#" class="cu-pagination-next">Next</a>
</nav>
```

**Segmented Control**
Active: `cu-segmented-item-active`
Sizes: `cu-segmented-sm`; full-width: add `cu-segmented-block`
```html
<div class="cu-segmented">
  <button class="cu-segmented-item cu-segmented-item-active">Day</button>
  <button class="cu-segmented-item">Week</button>
  <button class="cu-segmented-item">Month</button>
</div>
```

**Steps** — progress indicator
States: `cu-steps-item-active`, `cu-steps-item-completed`
```html
<div class="cu-steps">
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-completed">Step 1</div>
  <div class="cu-steps-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-steps-item cu-steps-item-active">Step 2</div>
  <div class="cu-steps-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-steps-item">Step 3</div>
</div>
```

**Menubar** — see Overlay section above.

**Speed Dial** — floating action button with expandable actions
Classes: `cu-speed-dial`, `cu-speed-dial-trigger`, `cu-speed-dial-actions`, `cu-speed-dial-action`, `cu-speed-dial-action-btn`, `cu-speed-dial-action-label`, `cu-speed-dial-sm`, `cu-speed-dial-horizontal`
Positions: `cu-speed-dial-bottom-right`, `cu-speed-dial-bottom-left`, `cu-speed-dial-top-right`, `cu-speed-dial-top-left`
Data: `data-cu-speed-dial`, `data-cu-speed-dial-trigger`, `data-cu-speed-dial-actions`
```html
<div class="cu-speed-dial cu-speed-dial-bottom-right" data-cu-speed-dial>
  <div class="cu-speed-dial-actions" data-cu-speed-dial-actions>
    <div class="cu-speed-dial-action">
      <span class="cu-speed-dial-action-label">Edit</span>
      <button class="cu-speed-dial-action-btn">✏️</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button class="cu-speed-dial-trigger" data-cu-speed-dial-trigger>+</button>
</div>
```

**Back to Top** — scroll-to-top button that appears after scrolling
Classes: `cu-back-to-top`, `cu-back-to-top-primary`, `cu-back-to-top-sm`, `cu-back-to-top-lg`, `cu-back-to-top-left`
Data: `data-cu-back-to-top`, `data-cu-back-to-top-threshold="300"`
```html
<button class="cu-back-to-top" data-cu-back-to-top data-cu-back-to-top-threshold="300" aria-label="Back to top">
  <svg><!-- chevron up --></svg>
</button>
```

### Layout

**Kanban** ⚡ Interactive — drag-and-drop board with columns and cards
Classes: `cu-kanban`, `cu-kanban-column`, `cu-kanban-column-header`, `cu-kanban-column-title`, `cu-kanban-column-count`, `cu-kanban-column-body`, `cu-kanban-card`, `cu-kanban-card-title`, `cu-kanban-card-description`, `cu-kanban-card-footer`, `cu-kanban-card-tag`, `cu-kanban-compact`, `cu-kanban-add`
Data: `data-cu-kanban`, `data-cu-kanban-column`, `data-cu-kanban-column-body`, `data-cu-kanban-card`
```html
<div class="cu-kanban" data-cu-kanban>
  <div class="cu-kanban-column" data-cu-kanban-column>
    <div class="cu-kanban-column-header">
      <span class="cu-kanban-column-title">To Do</span>
      <span class="cu-kanban-column-count">2</span>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-kanban-column-body" data-cu-kanban-column-body>
      <div class="cu-kanban-card" data-cu-kanban-card draggable="true">
        <div class="cu-kanban-card-title">Design mockups</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Carousel** ⚡ Interactive — horizontal slide carousel with snap scrolling
Classes: `cu-carousel` (container), `cu-carousel-viewport` (scroll container, snap-x), `cu-carousel-slide` (each slide, snap-start), `cu-carousel-multi-2` / `cu-carousel-multi-3` (show 2 or 3 slides at a time, add on carousel container), `cu-carousel-prev` / `cu-carousel-next` (arrow buttons, absolute center-y), `cu-carousel-dots` (dot indicators container), `cu-carousel-dot` (individual dot), `cu-carousel-dot-active` (active dot, primary color)
Data attributes: `data-cu-carousel`
```html
<div class="cu-carousel" data-cu-carousel>
  <div class="cu-carousel-viewport">
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide">Slide 1</div>
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide">Slide 2</div>
    <div class="cu-carousel-slide">Slide 3</div>
  </div>
  <button class="cu-carousel-prev" aria-label="Previous">‹</button>
  <button class="cu-carousel-next" aria-label="Next">›</button>
  <div class="cu-carousel-dots">
    <button class="cu-carousel-dot cu-carousel-dot-active" aria-label="Slide 1"></button>
    <button class="cu-carousel-dot" aria-label="Slide 2"></button>
    <button class="cu-carousel-dot" aria-label="Slide 3"></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Container**
Sizes: `cu-container-sm`, `cu-container-md`, `cu-container-lg`, `cu-container-xl`, `cu-container-2xl`, `cu-container-prose`
```html
<div class="cu-container cu-container-xl">Page content</div>
```

**Header**
```html
<header class="cu-header">
  <div class="cu-header-inner">
    <div class="cu-header-brand"><!-- logo --></div>
    <nav class="cu-header-nav cu-header-nav-md"><!-- nav items --></nav>
    <div class="cu-header-actions">
      <!-- buttons -->
      <button data-cu-mobile-nav-trigger="main-nav" class="cu-button cu-button-ghost cu-button-icon-sm md:hidden" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false">☰</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>
<!-- Mobile nav backdrop + panel -->
<div id="main-nav" class="cu-header-mobile-backdrop" data-cu-mobile-nav></div>
<nav id="main-nav-panel" class="cu-header-mobile-nav"
     data-cu-mobile-nav-panel="main-nav" data-cu-mobile-nav-clone
     role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Navigation menu">
  <div class="cu-header-mobile-header">
    <button data-cu-mobile-nav-close class="cu-header-mobile-close" aria-label="Close menu">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-header-mobile-content"><!-- auto-cloned from cu-header-nav --></div>
</nav>
```
Nav breakpoint modifiers: `cu-header-nav-sm`, `cu-header-nav-md`, `cu-header-nav-lg`, `cu-header-nav-xl` — hide nav below that breakpoint (cu-header-nav alone is always visible)
Nav alignment variants: `cu-header-nav-start` (left, next to brand), `cu-header-nav-end` (right, next to actions)
Mobile nav classes: `cu-header-mobile-nav` (right-side slide-in panel, w-72), `cu-header-mobile-backdrop` (overlay, bg-foreground/30), `cu-header-mobile-header` (justify-end), `cu-header-mobile-content`, `cu-header-mobile-close`
Mobile nav attrs: `data-cu-mobile-nav-trigger="id"`, `data-cu-mobile-nav`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-panel="id"`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-close`, `data-cu-mobile-nav-clone` (auto-clone desktop nav)

**Nav**
Active: `cu-nav-item-active`
Disabled: `cu-nav-item-disabled`
Vertical: add `cu-nav-vertical` to container
```html
<nav class="cu-nav">
  <a href="/" class="cu-nav-item cu-nav-item-active">Home</a>
  <a href="/about" class="cu-nav-item">About</a>
</nav>
```

**Sidebar**
```html
<aside class="cu-sidebar">
  <div class="cu-sidebar-header">Brand / Logo</div>
  <div class="cu-sidebar-content">
    <div class="cu-sidebar-section">
      <div class="cu-sidebar-section-title">SECTION</div>
      <div class="cu-sidebar-group">
        <div class="cu-sidebar-group-title">Group</div>
        <a href="#" class="cu-sidebar-item cu-sidebar-item-active">Active Link</a>
        <a href="#" class="cu-sidebar-item">Link</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <hr class="cu-sidebar-separator">
  </div>
  <div class="cu-sidebar-footer">Footer content</div>
</aside>
```

**Page Header**
Bordered variant: add `cu-page-header-bordered` for a bottom border (opt-in).
Centered variant: add `cu-page-header-centered` for center-aligned layout (opt-in, ideal for marketing/landing pages).
```html
<div class="cu-page-header">
  <div class="cu-page-header-content">
    <h1 class="cu-page-header-title">Page Title</h1>
    <p class="cu-page-header-description">Description</p>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-page-header-actions">
    <button class="cu-button cu-button-default">Action</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Filter Bar**
```html
<div class="cu-filter-bar">
  <div class="cu-filter-bar-inner">
    <div class="cu-filter-bar-search">
      <div class="cu-search-input-wrapper">
        <input type="search" class="cu-search-input" placeholder="Search...">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cu-filter-bar-filters">
      <!-- filter dropdowns, buttons -->
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Resizable Panels** ⚡ Interactive — draggable split pane layout
Classes: `cu-resizable` (container, flex row), `cu-resizable-vertical` (vertical split, flex-col), `cu-resizable-panel` (flex-grow panel, proportional sizing), `cu-resizable-handle` (drag handle, 6px wide/tall, col-resize/row-resize cursor, grip indicator via `::after`)
Handle states: `data-cu-resizing` attribute applied during drag (stronger highlight).
Panel constraints: `data-cu-min-size` / `data-cu-max-size` (percentage).
Data attributes: `data-cu-resizable`, `data-cu-resizable-panel`, `data-cu-resizable-handle`
```html
<div class="cu-resizable" data-cu-resizable>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 50">
    Left panel
  </div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-handle" data-cu-resizable-handle role="separator" tabindex="0"></div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 50">
    Right panel
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Vertical split -->
<div class="cu-resizable cu-resizable-vertical" data-cu-resizable>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 70">Top</div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-handle" data-cu-resizable-handle role="separator" tabindex="0"></div>
  <div class="cu-resizable-panel" data-cu-resizable-panel style="flex-grow: 30">Bottom</div>
</div>
```

**Scroll Area** — custom scrollbar styling
```html
<div class="cu-scroll-area" style="height: 200px">
  <!-- scrollable content -->
</div>
<!-- Horizontal: add cu-scroll-area-horizontal -->
```

**Toolbar**
```html
<div class="cu-toolbar">
  <div class="cu-toolbar-group">
    <button class="cu-toolbar-button">Bold</button>
    <button class="cu-toolbar-button">Italic</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cu-toolbar-separator"></div>
  <div class="cu-toolbar-group">
    <button class="cu-toolbar-button">Align Left</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### AI

**Chat Bubble** — `cu-chat-bubble`, variants: `cu-chat-bubble-user` (right-aligned, primary bg), `cu-chat-bubble-assistant` (left-aligned, muted bg). Parts: `cu-chat-bubble-avatar`, `cu-chat-bubble-content`, `cu-chat-bubble-name`, `cu-chat-bubble-message`, `cu-chat-bubble-timestamp`, `cu-chat-bubble-actions`, `cu-chat-bubble-action`. Modifier: `cu-chat-bubble-message-prose` for markdown content.
```html
<div class="cu-chat-bubble cu-chat-bubble-assistant">
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-avatar">
    <img src="avatar.png" alt="AI" />
  </div>
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-content">
    <span class="cu-chat-bubble-name">Assistant</span>
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-message">Hello! How can I help you?</div>
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-actions">
      <button class="cu-chat-bubble-action" aria-label="Copy"><!-- icon --></button>
    </div>
    <span class="cu-chat-bubble-timestamp">2:30 PM</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="cu-chat-bubble cu-chat-bubble-user">
  <div class="cu-chat-bubble-content">
    <div class="cu-chat-bubble-message">Can you help me with CSS?</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Chat Input** — `cu-chat-input`, `cu-chat-input-field` (auto-growing textarea), `cu-chat-input-actions`, `cu-chat-input-send` (primary button), `cu-chat-input-attach` (ghost button).
```html
<div class="cu-chat-input">
  <textarea class="cu-chat-input-field" placeholder="Type a message..." rows="1"></textarea>
  <div class="cu-chat-input-actions">
    <button class="cu-chat-input-send" aria-label="Send"><!-- icon --></button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Chat Typing** — `cu-chat-typing`, `cu-chat-typing-dot`. Animated bouncing dots for AI thinking indicator. Combine with `cu-chat-bubble` structure for contextual display.
```html
<div class="cu-chat-typing">
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
  <span class="cu-chat-typing-dot"></span>
</div>
```

## Interactive Components — Complete data-* Attribute Reference

| Component | Container | Trigger | Content | Close/Action | Other |
|-----------|-----------|---------|---------|-------------|-------|
| Tabs | `data-cu-tabs` | `data-cu-tabs-trigger="value"` | `data-cu-tabs-content="value"` | `data-cu-tabs-close` | `data-cu-tabs-scrollable` |
| Dropdown | `data-cu-dropdown` | `data-cu-dropdown-trigger` | `data-cu-dropdown-content` | — | — |
| Carousel | `data-cu-carousel` | — | — | — | — |
| Color Picker | `data-cu-color-picker` | — | — | — | `data-cu-color-picker-value`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation`, `data-cu-color-picker-saturation-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue`, `data-cu-color-picker-hue-pointer`, `data-cu-color-picker-preview`, `data-cu-color-picker-input`, `data-cu-color-picker-hidden`, `data-cu-color-picker-swatch` |
| Combobox | `data-cu-combobox` | `data-cu-combobox-trigger` | `data-cu-combobox-content` | — | `data-cu-combobox-input`, `data-cu-combobox-item`, `data-cu-combobox-value`, `data-cu-combobox-list`, `data-cu-combobox-empty` |
| Command Palette | `data-cu-command` | — | — | — | `data-cu-command-active` (on active item) |
| Context Menu | `data-cu-context-menu` | — | `data-cu-context-menu-content` | — | — |
| Date Picker | `data-cu-date-picker` | `data-cu-date-picker-trigger` | `data-cu-date-picker-content` | — | `data-cu-date-picker-value`, `data-cu-date-picker-input` (hidden) |
| Multi Select | `data-cu-multi-select` | `data-cu-multi-select-trigger` | `data-cu-multi-select-content` | — | `data-cu-multi-select-input`, `data-cu-multi-select-item`, `data-cu-multi-select-tags`, `data-cu-multi-select-placeholder`, `data-cu-multi-select-list`, `data-cu-multi-select-empty`, `data-cu-value` |
| Number Input | `data-cu-number-input` | `data-cu-number-increment` / `data-cu-number-decrement` | — | — | `data-cu-number-field` (on input) |
| Password Input | `data-cu-password-input` | — | — | — | `data-cu-password-toggle`, `data-cu-password-icon-show`, `data-cu-password-icon-hide` |
| Pin Input | `data-cu-pin-input` | — | — | — | `data-cu-pin-input-type` |
| Dropzone | `data-cu-dropzone` | — | — | — | `data-cu-dropzone-input` (on file input) |
| Resizable | `data-cu-resizable` | — | — | — | `data-cu-resizable-panel`, `data-cu-resizable-handle`, `data-cu-resizing` (on active handle), `data-cu-min-size`, `data-cu-max-size` |
| Transfer List | `data-cu-transfer-list` | `data-cu-transfer-to-right` / `data-cu-transfer-to-left` | `data-cu-transfer-panel="left\|right"` | — | `data-cu-transfer-check`, `data-cu-transfer-check-all="left\|right"`, `data-cu-transfer-count="left\|right"`, `data-cu-transfer-search="left\|right"`, `data-cu-value` |
| Dialog | — | `data-cu-dialog-trigger="id"` | `data-cu-dialog` (on `<dialog id="...">`) | `data-cu-dialog-close` | — |
| Drawer | — | `data-cu-drawer-trigger="id"` | `data-cu-drawer` (on `<dialog id="...">`) | `data-cu-drawer-close` | — |
| Alert Dialog | — | `data-cu-alert-dialog-trigger="id"` | `data-cu-alert-dialog` (on `<dialog id="...">`) | `data-cu-alert-dialog-cancel`, `data-cu-alert-dialog-action` | — |
| Toast | — | `data-cu-toast-trigger` | `data-cu-toast-container` | `data-cu-toast-close` | `data-cu-toast-title`, `data-cu-toast-description`, `data-cu-toast-variant`, `data-cu-toast-duration`, `data-cu-toast-max`. JS API: `CubbyUI.toast.show()`, `CubbyUI.toast.promise()` |
| Input Clearable | `data-cu-input-clearable` | — | — | `data-cu-input-clear` | — |
| Alert Expandable | `data-cu-alert-expandable` | `data-cu-alert-expand-trigger` | `data-cu-alert-expandable-content` | — | — |
| Data Table Expandable | `data-cu-data-table-expandable` | `data-cu-expand-row` | — | — | — |
| Popover | `data-cu-popover` | `data-cu-popover-trigger` | `data-cu-popover-content` | — | — |
| Menubar | `data-cu-menubar` | `data-cu-menubar-trigger` | `data-cu-menubar-content` | — | `data-cu-menubar-menu` (per menu wrapper) |
